'''Grabathar''' was a famed [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] war hero who fought in the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]] in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Playing off his status as a war hero, Grabathar started [[ThrillSpace Travel]], a travel company that offered tours of exotic locations across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Business boomed after the end of the Clone Wars, forcing Grabathar to add many more [[Captain/Legends|captains]] and [[Starship/Legends|starships]] into his operation.<ref name="TUR" />
